This entire video was edited by Claude. Not just the intro, the whole thing. It works with any coding agent, any model, and any editing app, and members of my Skool like Cyril and Andrew Fox are already posting outliers with it.

Here's how it works. The whole system is just a folder of files on your computer, and Claude (or any AI coding agent) uses those files and code to edit the video. Build one for your style (vlogs, short form, long form), and after every edit tell it to bake what it learned into the preset. Pretty soon it gets the edit right in one prompt.
